34:40.text: the Day when He will gather them all together, then He will say to the angels: "Was it you that these people used to worship?"

34:41.text: will say: "Glorified be You! You are our Walî
instead of them. Nay, but they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."

34:42.text: , none of you can profit or harm one another. And We shall say to those who did wrong
[i.e. worshipped others (like the angels, jinn, prophets, saints, righteous persons) along with Allâh]
: "Taste the torment of the Fire which you used to belie.

34:43.text: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, they say: "This
is naught but a man who wishes to hinder you from that which your fathers used to worship." And they say: "This
is nothing but an invented lie." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them
(i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم when Allâh sent him as a Messenger with proofs, evidence, verses of this Qur’ân, lessons, signs, etc.)

34:44.text: And We had not given them Scriptures which they could study, nor sent to them before you

34:45.text: And those before them belied; these have not received even a tenth of what We had granted to those
; yet they belied My Messengers. Then how

34:46.text: (to them O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
only: that you stand up for Allâh’s sake in pairs and singly, and reflect
(within yourselves the life history of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم)
: there is no madness in your companion
. He is only a warner to you in face of a severe torment."

34:47.text: : "Whatever wage I might have asked of you is yours. My wage is from Allâh only, and He is a Witness over all things."

34:48.text: (i.e. this Revelation that had come to me)
